name: ios-app
description: Build an iPhone/iPad (SwiftUI) app as an Xcode-ready artifact folder: the logic in a Swift package with tests (checked with run_build when a builder is configured), the app UI, and an XcodeGen project.yml so Xcode opens it without a hand-written .xcodeproj. Use when the user wants an iOS, iPhone or iPad app, or a project to open in Xcode.
author: pantheon

parameters.name: app_name
parameters.description: App name in UpperCamelCase, e.g. MarbleMaze
